562394.bio: Last year's champions with their first ever title, they will be aiming to go back-to-back this season.

55452.bio: Previous league champions and in the mix last season - will be hoping to go all the way this time.

1015305.bio: Champions in the season before last, but a disappointing performance last season in mid table.

382920.bio: A previous winner but second to last in the previous season - needs to improve to challenge the title this time out.

851808.bio: Another mid-table finisher last season and no title in 7 years - a sleeping giant or a forgotten team?

2932672.bio: Was two gameweeks away from a first title last season until bottling it against last place Ken - will be desperate to make amends this time around.

4821128.bio: Rarely trouble the top of the league, but were closer to mid-table than the bottom last season - signs of gradual improvement?

2937751.bio: Lost the title on the final day last season - can they pick themselves up and dust themselves off to go again this time? Past finishes suggest they will challenge again.

6250732.bio: Have often run out of steam early in the competition, starting strong last season but finishing 3rd from bottom. Expect more of the same this time around.

1000001.bio: Represent the average team, yet finished bottom of the table last season - always the potential to upset the other managers in the league, in more ways than one. Fireworks to be expected from a combustible manager.
